name: json-canvas
description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Trigger when the user opens, edits, or asks to create a .canvas file, or says "make a canvas", "build a mind map", "draw a flowchart in Obsidian", "add nodes to this canvas". Not for .md notes (use obsidian-markdown) or .base files (use obsidian-bases).
